api_key.description: The API key for the Kinsta API.

company_id.description: The ID of your Kinsta company.

admin_email.description: WordPress admin email (write-only, cannot be read back)

admin_password.description: WordPress admin password (write-only, cannot be read back)

admin_user.description: WordPress admin username (write-only, cannot be read back)

environment_id.description: The ID of the created environment

is_premium.description: Whether this is a premium staging environment (true) or standard staging (false) (write-only, cannot be read back)

site_id.description: The ID of the WordPress site to create the environment in

site_title.description: WordPress site title for this environment (write-only, cannot be read back)

wp_language.description: WordPress language (default: en_US) (write-only, cannot be read back)

admin_email.description: Email address for the WordPress admin account. Write-only: not returned by the API after creation.

admin_password.description: Password for the WordPress admin account. Write-only: not returned by the API after creation.

admin_user.description: Username for the WordPress admin account. Write-only: not returned by the API after creation.

display_name.description: A human-readable name for the site shown in MyKinsta (e.g., `my-production-site`).

environment_id.description: The unique identifier for the live environment automatically created with the site.

install_mode.description: WordPress installation mode. `new` (default) provisions the full WordPress install template — default theme, sample content, and the admin user from `admin_user`/`admin_email`/`admin_password`. `plain` creates an empty WordPress container per the spec's `addPlainWPSite-Body` shape (matches the "Empty site" option in the MyKinsta UI), suitable for sites whose contents are pushed by a downstream pipeline (e.g., Bedrock). `migrate` provisions an empty container in preparation for a migration request submitted via the MyKinsta UI; the migration flow itself is out of scope for this provider. **Important — `plain` mode body shape:** `addPlainWPSite-Body` only carries `company`, `display_name`, and `region`. `admin_email`, `admin_password`, `admin_user`, `site_title`, `wp_language`, and the multisite/WooCommerce/Yoast flags are **not sent to the API** when `install_mode = "plain"` — they are preserved in state for documentation but have no effect on create. For `new` and `migrate`, all those fields flow through to the API as documented.

is_multisite.description: Enable WordPress Multisite. Cannot be read back from the API after creation.

is_subdomain_multisite.description: Use subdomain-based multisite instead of subdirectory multisite. Only applies when `is_multisite` is `true`. Cannot be read back from the API after creation.

region.description: Data center region where the site is hosted (e.g., `us-central1`, `europe-west1`). See the [Kinsta API docs](https://api-docs.kinsta.com) for the full list of supported regions. Write-only: not returned by the API after creation.

site_id.description: The unique identifier for the WordPress site, used to reference this site in other resources.

site_title.description: WordPress site title displayed in the browser tab and site header. Write-only: not returned by the API after creation.

woocommerce.description: Pre-install the WooCommerce plugin. Cannot be read back from the API after creation.

wordpressseo.description: Pre-install the Yoast SEO plugin. Cannot be read back from the API after creation.
